purpose: Pipeline ownership and lifecycle contract for the shared Hero-Soldier Relation Layer. It establishes one semantic writer for Hero-Soldier membership and limits Hero/Soldier page pipelines to downstream consumption and presentation joins.

singleWriterPrinciple.rule: Only the Relation Layer may compute, merge, validate, publish, or replace canonical Hero-Soldier membership after A-10 adoption.

relationLayerResponsibilities: Read the canonical Hero and Soldier identities defined by A-1 and A-2.
Read only relation source fields authorized by A-3.
Normalize and compose direct/derived relation candidates according to A-4 and A-5.
Write the A-6 canonical Relation Set.
Generate both A-7 indexes from the exact same accepted Relation Set.
Run A-8 integrity, fixture, regression and parity validation.
Publish relation artifacts for downstream use only when A-8 records PASS for the exact artifact blobs.
Own future semantic relation changes by versioning the relevant A-contract before changing builder behavior.

allowed: Join returned soldierId values to Soldier Master for names, class, SP/display metadata and links.
Resolve provenance from the A-6 canonical edge only when diagnostics or evidence are needed.
Cache page-local presentation results when the cache is invalidated by relation/index or master blob changes.
forbidden: Re-read ConfigDataSoldierInfo.GetSoldierHeros_ID to independently calculate usable Soldiers.
Infer Soldier membership by name, numeric ID pattern, SP form, tier or UI metadata.
Write or patch canonical Relation Set/index artifacts.
Treat Hero page data as an authoritative relation source.

heroStageMapping.Hero 5-3 usable Soldiers: Consume byHeroId only for membership; join Soldier Master for presentation.
heroStageMapping.Hero 5-4 SP display: May display SP-specific Hero data, but Soldier membership remains owned by the Relation Layer.

allowedBeforeA10: Complete the current UnityDataTool JSON input migration/regression work needed to prove that Soldier, SP Soldier and SP Hero relation-source fields are readable and semantically unchanged.
Validate Soldier Master and domain-specific Soldier/SP records needed as Relation Layer inputs.
Compare migrated source extraction against the frozen stage-3 Golden Baseline for regression diagnosis.
allowedAfterA10: Lookup heroIds[] by canonical soldierId from bySoldierId.
Join returned heroId values to Hero Master for names and page links.
Consume Relation Layer validation status as the readiness gate for usable-Hero display.
Continue Soldier-specific stats, abilities, missions, training and presentation work independently of relation membership.
forbiddenAfterA10: Independently rebuild final Hero-Soldier membership from stage-3/4 intermediate data.
Maintain a second canonical Soldier->Hero relation file.
Use legacy data/generated/soldier-hero-relations.v1.json as live production truth.
Modify canonical relation artifacts to make Soldier-page checks pass.

soldierStageMapping.Soldier 4-1 through 4-5: Transitional upstream migration/regression gates for current UnityDataTool JSON and relation-source readability; they do not become a parallel final-relation owner.
soldierStageMapping.Soldier 4-6: After A-10 adoption, consume or invoke the shared Relation Layer result rather than independently regenerate a separate final Hero<->Soldier relation.
soldierStageMapping.Soldier 4-7 and later relation fixtures: Use A-8 shared fixtures/validation where relation semantics overlap; keep Soldier-only fixtures for non-relation domain checks.
soldierStageMapping.Soldier 5 usable Heroes: Consume bySoldierId only for membership; join Hero Master for presentation.

legacyArtifactPolicy.retirementRule: Keep until the new Relation Layer has passed A-10 and any desired migration comparison is complete; deletion/archival is a separate explicit cleanup decision.

rules: A newly generated Relation Set or index is not production-ready merely because the file exists.
A-8 PASS for the exact relation-set/index blobs promotes the artifact group to PASS_ACCEPTED.
Any required input blob or semantic contract change makes previously generated relation artifacts STALE for that new snapshot.
Hero and Soldier consumers must use one mutually consistent PASS_ACCEPTED artifact group, not mix files from different relation-set SHAs.
A REVIEW or FAIL group must not silently replace the last accepted group.

changeOwnership.gameDataChange: Relation Layer is regenerated after upstream source/master readiness is established; differences are classified by A-8.
changeOwnership.heroNameOrSoldierNameChange: Update the relevant Master only; do not regenerate semantic relation edges unless canonical IDs/source evidence changed.
changeOwnership.presentationChange: Hero/Soldier page layers may change without touching Relation Layer semantics.
changeOwnership.newRelationSourceMeaning: Version A-3 and all affected downstream contracts before builder adoption.
changeOwnership.identityRuleChange: Version A-1 or A-2 and affected downstream contracts; never silently remap existing relation IDs.
changeOwnership.compositionRuleChange: Version A-5 and affected downstream contracts before regenerating production relation data.

currentTransition: Complete Soldier 4-1 through 4-5 UnityDataTool JSON migration/regression gates
Run A-10 shared Relation Layer generation from current canonical inputs
Generate A-7 indexes from the A-10 Relation Set
Run A-8 validation against the exact generated blobs
Accept/publish the group only on PASS
Resume Soldier 4-6+ and Hero 5-3+ as consumers of the shared artifacts
executionOrder.reason: The shared semantic contract can be frozen before migration completion, but the first current-snapshot Relation Set must not be accepted until the required JSON source adapters/inputs are proven reliable.

required: A-6 Relation Set exists for the intended current input snapshot
A-7 by-Hero and by-Soldier indexes reference that exact Relation Set
A-8 validation status is PASS for those exact blobs
downstreamReadinessGate.onFailure: Keep the previous accepted relation group or block relation-dependent page generation; never fall back to an independent page-specific recomputation.

ownershipInvariant: There is exactly one semantic Hero-Soldier membership owner: the shared Relation Layer. All other layers are upstream data providers/validators or downstream consumers, never parallel semantic authorities.
completion: A-9 is complete when relation computation, validation, publication, migration sequencing, legacy handling and downstream Hero/Soldier consumption all have a single non-overlapping owner boundary, with A-10 defined as the first actual current-snapshot implementation gate.
